items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I heard Slim Freeman who came to Des Moines with this Midnight Ramblers from Chicago... wanting to be a tenor player in the first place, you know, from listening to Hawkins, Slim.

ctx.x: Had you played a tenor before?
No, I hadn't played tenor, but I had the tenor idea from listening to Coleman Hawkins and I heard Slim Freeman who came to Des Moines with this Midnight

Ramblers from Chicago and they were playing all the Fletcher Henderson arrangements. Well, Slim was -- but that's my whole build-up, was wanting to be a tenor player in the first place, you know, from listening to Hawkins, Slim. And I'll tell you the story.
